title: Route requests and fail over streamed responses
prompt: Fail over between supplied provider(request)->chunk-iterator callbacks. A RuntimeError before any NONEMPTY emitted chunk permits trying the next provider; after any output return a terminal partial-stream error, never concatenate another provider's answer. Return collected chunks, attempt log, and status. This deterministic core treats RuntimeError as retryable; provider selection/billing are external.
